name: Clover Club Cocktail
desc: Gin, lemon, raspberry syrup and egg white, shaken into a pink foamy sour.

source.title: Clover Club Cocktail
source.evidence: Same gin, fresh lemon, raspberry syrup and egg white sour with a dry shake then a shake on ice; Imbibe's version also adds 1/2 oz dry vermouth.

ingredients.raw: 1 large egg white (or 1 oz pasteurized liquid egg white)
ingredients.note: or 1 oz pasteurized liquid egg white

steps: Chill a coupe glass in the freezer while you mix.
Add the gin, lemon juice, raspberry syrup and egg white to a shaker with no ice. Dry shake hard for 15 seconds to foam the egg white.
Fill the shaker with ice and shake again until the outside is very cold, about 15 seconds.
Strain through a fine strainer into the chilled coupe. Garnish with the raspberries on a pick.
tips: Homemade raspberry syrup (Imbibe): muddle 1 part raspberries with 2 parts sugar, let sit 20 to 30 minutes until syrupy, stir in 1 part water until the sugar dissolves, and strain. Do not boil it or the fruit tastes cooked.
The egg white is raw. Use pasteurized egg white if serving anyone pregnant, very young, elderly or immunocompromised.
Imbibe and Difford's Guide both add 1/2 oz dry vermouth and use 1 1/2 oz gin; this version leaves the vermouth out.
